caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely flat, and it is never fast. When I scout routes for My Adventure Costa Rica, I look for these forgotten agricultural tracks—steep gradients and rich, clay-heavy soil that demand both patience and a quiet gear. I design every journey to embrace these climbs, because the view from the ridge is only earned when you have worked for every meter. Which do you find more rewarding: the focus of the climb, or the freedom of the descent?
